name: BAS first pass
summary: Prepares the BAS first pass for an accounting practice's client in Xero: reads the period's bank transactions, queues the agreed coding for approval, and lists what the accountant must check by hand before the return. Crons read and queue; an accountant approves every change and lodges the BAS.

covered_by.trigger-quarter-end: not covered: period_start is set in settings for each quarter
covered_by.document-scan: exceptions cron (lists transactions with no source document attached)
covered_by.bank-feed-pull: pull-period cron (reads authorised bank transactions for the period)
covered_by.categorise-lines: code-lines cron (queues coding for approval when an agreed rule matches)
covered_by.gst-coding: pull-period cron (reads tax rates and flags tax types that are not active)
covered_by.reconcile: exceptions cron (flags unreconciled lines through the same list); no write
covered_by.draft-bas: skill (the accountant prepares the BAS from the reviewed lines)
covered_by.lodge-bas: not covered: lodgement stays with the accountant in the ATO channel

crons.name: pull-period
crons.summary: Read the period's authorised bank transactions and tax rates from Xero.

crons.name: code-lines
crons.summary: Queue a coding change for each single-line transaction an agreed rule matches.

crons.name: exceptions
crons.summary: List the transactions the accountant must check by hand before the BAS.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads. The crons write only the internal period snapshot and the exceptions list. A coding change edits the books, so it is live and waits for an accountant.

xero.covers: authorised bank transactions for the period, tax rates, and queued coding changes to a single-line transaction

gaps: MYOB: only the GST tax-code operations are mapped in the kit. Bank feed, categorise, reconcile and BAS draft steps have no mapped operation, so no MYOB adapter is built. Confirm on a live MYOB file.
Xero: the bank feed connection, the reconciliation status and the GST return report are not built. The reconciliation flag is read only.
Xero: the BAS form fields (G1, 1A, 1B) are not on the Xero pages in the platform docs, so the BAS itself is prepared by the accountant, not by a cron.
Document scanning: the docs say about 30 of the 50 minutes is scanning, but no operation reads attachment contents. The exceptions list flags missing documents only.
Partner sign-off, lodgement and client communication are judgment and human steps. The docs do not show a platform step for them.
Coding rules are per client and must be agreed with the accountant before code-lines queues anything. With no rules, nothing is queued.

Needs core: an approved coding change is sent exactly as it was queued, with no re-read, so a line the accountant coded by hand after queueing is overwritten. The runtime's approve step must re-read the transaction and refuse unless it is still a single uncoded, unreconciled line. The cron cannot close this window: it runs once a day and approval can come sooner.
The Xero adapter is docs-only until a Xero demo organisation proves the reads and the coding update.
